content: Discogs API: authenticated (token/OAuth) callers get 60 req/min per IP vs 25 req/min unauthenticated; rate headers X-Discogs-Ratelimit(-Used/-Remaining); wantlist add uses PUT /users/{username}/wants/{release_id} (naturally idempotent by release_id in URL) while POST updates an existing wantlist entry's notes/rating; OAuth 1.0a supported, personal access tokens simpler for single-user scripts.
